topic: What beam management strategies are needed to mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band?
consensus_response: To mitigate >3 dB gain variance, analog beamforming and rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) are employed. ML algorithms optimize beam patterns, adapting to channel conditions and phase shifter limitations. Beam squint effects are compensated by dynamic beamforming, ensuring spectral efficiency and minimizing inter-beam interference.
reference_context: SatCom systems use beamforming to mitigate interference, with techniques like RSMA and analog beamforming enhancing spectral efficiency.
